name: google-store-hours-near-landmark
intent: Find a store's Sunday opening hours for the location nearest a given landmark restaurant via a single targeted Google search
summary: Looks up business hours by navigating directly to a Google search URL that pairs the target store with the nearby landmark (e.g. 'Patel Brothers near Anjappar Dallas Sunday hours'). The results page AI Overview directly answers with the specific store's Sunday hours, address, and phone, which are then saved as a note. Reusable template: swap store name, landmark, city, and day.
route_strategy: Skip the search box entirely; Navigate straight to https://www.google.com/search?q={encoded query}. Verify the results page shows an AI Overview / knowledge panel with the day's hours for the specific store, then extract and save the answer. Do not reproduce the generic first query or the wait loop from the source trace.

do: Build one specific query combining store name + 'near' + landmark + city + day + 'hours' (e.g. 'Patel Brothers near Anjappar Dallas Sunday hours') and URL-encode it
Navigate directly to the Google search results URL instead of typing into the search box
After navigation, confirm the results page title matches the query and that an AI Overview or business panel shows the target day's hours
Extract the hours together with the store address and phone so the specific location is unambiguous
Save the answer as a note with the source query recorded
Preserve goal-specific target hints: find, out, patel, bros, dallas, near, anjappar, restraunt.
Prefer the observed successful final URL when it still matches the goal: https://www.google.com/search?q=Patel+Brothers+near+Anjappar+Dallas+Sunday+hours.
Patch: Issue the full pairing query in one shot: '<store> near <landmark> <city> <day> hours', navigating directly to the Google search URL.
Patch: Never chain waits when the page is loaded and the needed next action is known; proceed immediately to the next navigation or extraction step.
avoid: Do not use a generic query like 'Patel Bros Dallas hours Sunday' — it returns multiple DFW locations and does not identify the one near the landmark (this caused the original stall)
Do not chain TimedWait steps while the page is already loaded (ready_state complete) — the source trace burned ~50 waits making no progress
Do not try to disambiguate the correct store from a generic multi-location results page; re-query with the landmark pairing instead
Do not replay source step 1: Initial TimedWait on about:blank with no observable effect.
Do not replay source step 2: Detour: generic query 'Patel Bros Dallas hours Sunday' returned multiple DFW locations and never identified the store near Anjappar.
Do not replay source step 3: TimedWait stall: steps 3–52 are ~50 consecutive 1s waits, all verification_status no_change, while the results page was already loaded; none moved toward the answer.
Avoid failure: Generic query 'Patel Bros Dallas hours Sunday' produced multi-location results that could not be tied to the Anjappar landmark, leading to a prolonged stall.
Avoid failure: Agent looped TimedWait ~50 times on an already-loaded page (ready_state complete) instead of acting.
checkpoints: After the Navigate: results page loaded, title contains the query terms, and an AI Overview / hours panel for the specific store is visible
After extraction: saved note contains the day's hours plus address/phone for the location tied to the landmark
Target page title should resemble: [Tab 1/1] Patel Brothers near Anjappar Dallas Sunday hours - Google Search.
Pause after dynamic search/result-selection states unless the next action is replay-safe.
stop_conditions: No AI Overview or hours panel appears for the specific store — hand back to the live agent to open the business listing
Results show conflicting hours for multiple similarly-named locations without landmark context
The results page requires interaction (consent wall, captcha) that the direct navigation did not anticipate
If the current page no longer matches the workflow state, stop replay and hand back to the live planner.
If an answer text must be read from the current screenshot, stop before templated SaveNote and let the live answer finalizer read it.

quality.reason: Successful answer came from a single specific Google search ('store near landmark + day + hours') whose AI Overview contained the Sunday hours; the generic first query caused a 50-step stall and is discarded. The query pattern is reusable as a template for any store-hours-near-landmark lookup.
